#Aletheia #Environment 🌐

By replacing synthetic monopolies with biological intelligence, the farm fosters a transparent, low-strain loop that empowers both soil and community.

When you map ecological alignment with ground-level sustainability, it plots a direct trajectory toward Grace. Positive feedback loops expand future potential.

The Unavoidable Lie: Industrial agriculture claims chemical dependency is the only path to feed the world.
